description: This PHP source file defines the EmailSubscriberAPI class, an API endpoint for managing email subscribers within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting email subscribers associated with specific email notifications, along with OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing email subscribers tied to email notifications. It supports listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting subscribers, with validation and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of email subscribers for a specified email subscription, including support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new email subscriber for a specified email subscription based on provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more email subscribers based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific email subscriber by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing email subscriber's details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new email subscriber.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting email subscribers.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a specific email subscriber.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an existing email subscriber.
